mapper.select: SELECT ddovyo.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.user_source, t.user_type, t.total_record_num, t.total_user_num, t.process_record_num, t.process_user_num, t.success_amount, t.success_fee, t.success_change_amount, t.success_change_fee, t.success_record_num, t.success_user_num, t.failed_record_num, t.failed_user_num FROM (SELECT duwr.update_dates dates, duwr.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, 0 user_type, count(1) total_record_num, count(DISTINCT duwr.user_id) total_user_num, count(case when duwr.status = 0 then duwr.status end) process_record_num, count(DISTINCT (case when duwr.status = 0 then duwr.user_id end)) process_user_num, IFNULL(sum(case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.amount ELSE 0 end), 0) success_amount, IFNULL(sum(case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.fee ELSE 0 end), 0) success_fee, IFNULL(sum(case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.change_amount ELSE 0 end), 0) success_change_amount, IFNULL(sum(case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.change_fee ELSE 0 end), 0) success_change_fee, count(case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.status end) success_record_num, count(DISTINCT (case when duwr.status = 1 then duwr.user_id end)) success_user_num, count(case when duwr.status = 2 then duwr.status end) failed_record_num, count(DISTINCT (case when duwr.status = 2 then duwr.user_id end)) failed_user_num FROM dwd_user_payment_record duwr left join dim_user_source dus on (duwr.user_id = dus.user_id) WHERE duwr.update_dates = #{dates} group by duwr.update_dates, duwr.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_usrc_payment ddovyo on (t.dates = ddovyo.dates and t.pkg = ddovyo.pkg and t.user_source = ddovyo.user_source and t.user_type = ddovyo.user_type)
